_howto: North Dakota results come straight from the same public data feed the official results site uses (api.resultsnd.sos.nd.gov), so no download link is needed. electionID 348 is the 2026 General Election. If the data stops appearing, check the Sources tab. 'types' limits which contest types are fetched (SW statewide, LEG legislative, JUD judicial, CW county, CON conservation, MUN city, SCH school). The CSV-export reader is still supported by adding a 'sources' list instead of 'api'.

nd.label: North Dakota Secretary of State (official results feed, unofficial until canvassed)
